Zips are fine as a download format for you to store locally.

But once you’re back in ChatGPT, you only have ~25 file slots, so the OS itself needs to live in as few files as possible (ideally 1–2).

The rebuilt OS must be LLM-first + sandbox-native, not “Python runtime that happens to be described in JSON.”

Given that, I’m committing us to:
